ChartLite automatically maps your ICD-10 diagnoses to the most common CPT procedure codes and calculates tariffs using SAMA (South African Medical Association) reference rates. In production, this integrates with your medical aid scheme\'s fee schedule for precise reimbursement amounts.
This is the X12N v5010A1 payload that would be transmitted to the medical aid/payer via EDI.
